findings: TodoMVC refresh 311.5 ms = invalidate 88.3 + commit 68.0 + collect 32.5 + resolve 26.5 + occurs 16.7 + merge 10.0 + deps 8.2 + order 0.8, with roughly 60 ms left in loop overhead, scratch take/recycle and probe timestamps.

The previous record described the 68.1 ms bucket as retain_requirement_order plus set_order plus touch. The split shows retain_requirement_order is only 0.833 ms: the bucket is the commit path (set_order, binding update and touch) and it is dominated by the touch scheduling walk.

Invalidation is 88.3 ms against only 12,541 dirty pops, 14,988 affected cells, 25,231 variable visits and 12,690 edge visits, so the requirement cone BFS is not the cost: both large buckets are dominated by about 27,000 touch calls at roughly 5-6 us each inside schedule_variable's transitive dependent walk.

Intern requests inside refresh: TodoMVC 164,211 of 814,114 (resolve 121,013, merge 40,348, order 2,850); NovyWave 394,531 of 1,067,405 (resolve 252,978, merge 138,947, order 2,606). Refresh interning is a minority of total interning, so the interning bloat theory cannot explain the whole K0 gap.
NovyWave refresh 263.2 ms = merge 156.5 + resolve 37.1 + order 14.6 + deps 12.4 + occurs 11.5 + invalidate 3.7 + collect 2.9 + commit 2.2, so its remaining cost is the recursive merge itself.
Closed-pair caching stays dead: closed merges are 27 of 44,262 TodoMVC contributor visits and 46 of 119,920 NovyWave contributor visits (distinct closed pairs 5 and 3).
Fold memo hits: TodoMVC 6,239 of 18,792 evaluations (33%), NovyWave 1,708 of 6,425 (27%).

caveats: One observation per fixture: these are attribution numbers, not acceptance measurements.

These are single observations, not medians: the TodoMVC observation ran 1203.7 ms end to end against the A/B/A p50 of 1067-1073 ms, and the probe adds Instant::now pairs per fold, so the absolute sub-phase values are inflated relative to the acceptance medians. The ratios and the counter values are the result.
Sub-phase totals do not sum to total_ms; the residual is loop overhead, scratch checkout/recycle and probe timestamps.
